A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SLMRec research work, with 22 complete pages including Appendices A–C. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish that only Equation (6) and the arXiv version/date stamp differ.

before.justification: v3 reports original recommendation experiments on four Amazon categories, including accuracy, efficiency, ablations and model studies in Section 5 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix B, including accuracy comparisons, efficiency measurements and ablations.

M1.justification: Equation (6) replaces +λ1Dcos with +λ1(1 − Dcos). Because Equation (3) defines cosine similarity, this reverses that term's optimization direction to encourage teacher–student alignment. This is a localized correction to the stated training objective; the PDFs do not establish an implementation change or rerun.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Amazon Cloth, Movie, Music and Sport data for the same sequential recommendation tasks and test scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the accuracy, efficiency and model studies, including Open-P5, E4SRec variants and the traditional and self-supervised recommenders.

E3.justification: The reported splits, preprocessing, 999-negative-item sampling, ranking metrics, model sizes, batch sizes and training budgets remain unchanged in Sections 2 and 5 and Appendix B.

E4.justification: The layer-depth experiments, regularizer ablations, online distillation comparison and block-count study are unchanged in Figures 2, 4 and 5 and Tables 4 and 9.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results and reported findings are identical, including Tables 2–5 and 7–9 and Figures 2, 4 and 5. The objective correction is not accompanied by revised experimental outcomes.

T1.justification: Equation (6) changes the mathematical definition of the total objective through the corrected cosine term; this is not equivalent notation. The theoretical propositions in Section 6 and their Appendix A proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about layer redundancy, knowledge distillation, competitive accuracy with fewer parameters, efficiency gains and theoretical justification.

C2.justification: The explanations of the results and applicability limitations are unchanged, including Section 8's limitation that new scenarios require retraining rather than few-shot adaptation.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures, Appendix B training details, Table 6 hyperparameters, hardware information and code/data access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 7, Appendix C, the reference list and the positioning relative to earlier research are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v3 dated 27 January 2025 to v4 dated 20 April 2025. Prose, terminology, headings and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions and their placement are unchanged. The corrected equation occupies the same location without document reflow.

improvement.justification: v4 corrects Equation (6) so that minimizing its cosine term encourages the representation alignment described in Section 4, resolving a sign inconsistency in the training specification. This improves mathematical correctness and reproducibility of the stated method. Results and proofs are unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish that the implementation or experiments changed.
